question.problem: The projection of the intersection between the hyperboloid of two sheets $\frac{(x-1)^{2}}{20}+\frac{(y-2)^{2}}{16}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{80}=-1$ and the plane $y=4$ onto the $xz$-plane is a hyperbola. What are the lengths of the semi-axes of the hyperbola?
question.worked_solution:
To find the intersection of the hyperboloid and the plane $y=4$, we substitute $y=4$ into the equation of the hyperboloid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(x-1)^{2}}{20}+\frac{(4-2)^{2}}{16}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{80} & =-1 \\ \frac{(x-1)^{2}}{20}+\frac{1}{4}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{80} & =-1 \\ \frac{(x-1)^{2}}{20}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{80} & =-1-\frac{1}{4} \\ \frac{(x-1)^{2}}{20}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{80} & =-\frac{5}{4} \\ -\frac{(x-1)^{2}}{25}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{100} & =1 \\ -\frac{(x-1)^{2}}{{5}^{2}}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{{10}^{2}} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us the equation of a hyperbola with semi-axes of lengths $10$ and $5.$
